I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling in your palms. To better understand your condition, have you noticed any specific rash patterns, such as redness, scaling, or blistering on your hands?

Additionally, do you have any other medical conditions like diabetes, thyroid issues, or autoimmune disorders?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leptospirosis with acute renal failure and hepatitis.

The patient's history of working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, combined with a pruritic rash and neurological symptoms, is highly suggestive of leptospirosis, which can cause multi-organ involvement including renal and hepatic dysfunction. I will now request relevant laboratory tests to confirm this diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Complete_blood_count, Serum_chemistry_panel, Liver_function_tests, Renal_function_tests, Urinalysis, Leptospira_serology.
